description: Leggings of Arcana Level 60 In order to create the Leggings of Arcana, you will be required to bring the following items back to Malyfous Darkhammer: 1 Pristine Hide of the Beast; 5 Frayed Abomination Stitchings; 5 Arcanite Bars; 5 Frostwhisper's Embalming Fluid. You will also be required to pay 50 gold pieces for the crafting of the item. Requirements: - Frayed Abomination Stitching x 5 - Arcanite Bar x 5 - Frostwhisper's Embalming Fluid x 5 - Money: 50
name: Leggings of Arcana
